verdict.rationale: Make's official MCP server lets AI clients such as Claude and ChatGPT run scenarios and view or modify scenarios, connections, webhooks and data stores. Make Skills help those assistants build scenarios and configure modules, so users can operate Make in natural language. This only works through an external AI client, though; nothing shows a native natural-language command interface inside Make. missing for 10: native in-product natural-language control, hands-on or independent corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably, documentation of the full range of operations covered by the MCP tools.
